Hi Sara —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap from my side so we’re aligned:

- Goal: evaluate Redwood for low-latency, cost-efficient serving of your patient-triage model across regional clusters.
- Key constraints you mentioned: strict data residency, SOC 2 evidence, predictable p99 latency <= 120ms for 2k QPS, and support for mixed-precision quantized models.
- Success criteria for pilot: functional demo of a representative model, perf numbers (latency/cost), and an integration checklist for your infra/procurement teams.

Per our conversation, the right next step is a technical deep-dive + demo with our ML/infra engineers (60–90 minutes). Please confirm:

1) Who from your side should attend (names + roles)?
2) Do you prefer a 60- or 90-minute session? We recommend 90m if you want to include the procurement checklist review and SOC 2 Q&A.
3) Which of these slots works for you (Pacific):
   - Thu Feb 26, 14:00–15:30 PT (90m)
   - Fri Feb 27, 10:00–11:00 PT (60m)

I’ve attached a draft agenda (Redwood_DeepDive_Agenda_v1.docx) and a short pre-read that explains our batching/kv-cache approach.

If those times don't work, tell me a couple windows next week and I’ll coordinate. Once you confirm, I’ll loop in our ML lead (Karthik) and solutions engineer (Priyom) to run the session.

Best,

- Short perf baselines (latency & cost) for two representative models: ~600M and ~13B (low and mid/high capacity scenarios).
